figs.name: plc-block-diagram-modules-diagram
figs.alt: PLC block diagram showing input module, CPU, memory, output module and power supply
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog showing a PLC block diagram: field inputs, input module, CPU with processor and memory, output module, field devices and power supply.
figs.after_h2: Important Parts of a PLC System
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 500" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>PLC block diagram with input module, CPU, memory, output module and power supply</title>
<rect width="800" height="500" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#1e3a8a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">PLC Block Diagram</text>
<rect x="20" y="110" width="150" height="230" rx="10" fill="#fff7e6" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="95.0" y="184.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Field inputs</text>
<text x="95.0" y="207.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Push buttons</text>
<text x="95.0" y="230.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Limit switches</text>
<text x="95.0" y="253.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Sensors</text>
<text x="95.0" y="276.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Transmitters</text>
<rect x="200" y="140" width="130" height="170" rx="10" fill="#eff6ff" stroke="#2563eb" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="265.0" y="207.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Input</text>
<text x="265.0" y="231.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">module</text>
<text x="265.0" y="255.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">DI and AI</text>
<rect x="360" y="100" width="190" height="250" rx="14" fill="#eff6ff" stroke="#2563eb" stroke-width="3"/>
<text x="455" y="135" font-size="24" fill="#1e3a8a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">CPU</text>
<rect x="380" y="155" width="150" height="70" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#2563eb" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="455.0" y="184.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Processor</text>
<text x="455.0" y="207.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">runs the scan</text>
<rect x="380" y="245" width="150" height="80" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#2563eb" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="455.0" y="279.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Memory</text>
<text x="455.0" y="302.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">program and data</text>
<rect x="580" y="140" width="130" height="170" rx="10" fill="#eff6ff" stroke="#2563eb" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="645.0" y="207.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Output</text>
<text x="645.0" y="231.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">module</text>
<text x="645.0" y="255.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">DO and AO</text>
<line x1="170" y1="225" x2="198" y2="225" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<line x1="330" y1="225" x2="358" y2="225" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<line x1="550" y1="225" x2="578" y2="225" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<line x1="710" y1="225" x2="735" y2="225" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="760" y="200" font-size="16" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Motors</text>
<text x="760" y="225" font-size="16" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Valves</text>
<text x="760" y="250" font-size="16" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Lamps</text>
<rect x="330" y="395" width="250" height="60" rx="10" fill="#fef9c3" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="455.0" y="419.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Power supply</text>
<text x="455.0" y="442.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">24 V DC to all modules</text>
<polyline points="455,395 455,352" fill="none" stroke="#ca8a04" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<polyline points="330,425 265,425 265,312" fill="none" stroke="#ca8a04" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<polyline points="580,425 645,425 645,312" fill="none" stroke="#ca8a04" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="600" y="60" width="180" height="60" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#2563eb" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="690.0" y="84.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Programming</text>
<text x="690.0" y="107.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">device or HMI</text>
<polyline points="600,90 552,120" fill="none" stroke="#2563eb" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)" stroke-dasharray="6 4"/>
</svg>

figs.name: plc-block-diagram-scan-cycle-flowchart
figs.alt: PLC scan cycle flowchart read inputs execute program update outputs and housekeeping
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog showing the repeating PLC scan cycle: read inputs, execute the program, update outputs and housekeeping, usually in a few milliseconds.
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 480" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>PLC scan cycle flowchart read inputs execute program update outputs</title>
<rect width="800" height="480" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#1e3a8a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">PLC Scan Cycle: What the CPU Repeats</text>
<rect x="285" y="78" width="230" height="84" rx="10" fill="#eff6ff" stroke="#2563eb" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400.0" y="114.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">1. Read inputs</text>
<text x="400.0" y="138.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">copy input image</text>
<rect x="525" y="208" width="230" height="84" rx="10" fill="#eff6ff" stroke="#2563eb" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="640.0" y="244.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">2. Execute</text>
<text x="640.0" y="268.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">program logic</text>
<rect x="285" y="338" width="230" height="84" rx="10" fill="#eff6ff" stroke="#2563eb" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400.0" y="374.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">3. Update outputs</text>
<text x="400.0" y="398.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">write output image</text>
<rect x="45" y="208" width="230" height="84" rx="10" fill="#eff6ff" stroke="#2563eb" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="160.0" y="244.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">4. Housekeeping</text>
<text x="160.0" y="268.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">comms and diagnostics</text>
<line x1="515" y1="120" x2="640" y2="205" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<line x1="640" y1="295" x2="515" y2="380" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<line x1="285" y1="380" x2="160" y2="295" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<line x1="160" y1="205" x2="285" y2="120" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="400" y="245" font-size="22" fill="#1e3a8a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">One scan</text>
<text x="400" y="272" font-size="18" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">typically a few ms</text>
<text x="400" y="460" font-size="18" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">An input that changes mid scan is seen only at the next read.</text>
</svg>

figs.name: plc-block-diagram-io-modules-infographic
figs.alt: PLC input and output modules DI AI DO AO with signal types and example devices
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog listing PLC input and output module types with their signals and typical field devices for DI, AI, DO and AO.
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 450" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>PLC input and output module signal types with field device examples</title>
<rect width="800" height="450" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#1e3a8a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">PLC I/O Modules at a Glance</text>
<rect x="30" y="60" width="740" height="44" rx="8" fill="#2563eb"/>
<text x="90" y="89" font-size="19" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Type</text>
<text x="240" y="89" font-size="19" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Module</text>
<text x="440" y="89" font-size="19" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Signal</text>
<text x="640" y="89" font-size="19" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Example device</text>
<rect x="30" y="110" width="740" height="64" rx="8" fill="#eff6ff" stroke="#e5e7eb" stroke-width="1.5"/>
<text x="90" y="150" font-size="22" fill="#1e3a8a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">DI</text>
<text x="240" y="150" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Digital input</text>
<text x="440" y="150" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">24 V DC on or off</text>
<text x="640" y="150" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Push button, limit switch</text>
<rect x="30" y="180" width="740" height="64" rx="8" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#e5e7eb" stroke-width="1.5"/>
<text x="90" y="220" font-size="22" fill="#1e3a8a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">AI</text>
<text x="240" y="220" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Analog input</text>
<text x="440" y="220" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">4 to 20 mA, 0 to 10 V</text>
<text x="640" y="220" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Pressure transmitter, RTD</text>
<rect x="30" y="250" width="740" height="64" rx="8" fill="#eff6ff" stroke="#e5e7eb" stroke-width="1.5"/>
<text x="90" y="290" font-size="22" fill="#1e3a8a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">DO</text>
<text x="240" y="290" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Digital output</text>
<text x="440" y="290" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Relay or transistor</text>
<text x="640" y="290" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Motor starter, solenoid</text>
<rect x="30" y="320" width="740" height="64" rx="8" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#e5e7eb" stroke-width="1.5"/>
<text x="90" y="360" font-size="22" fill="#1e3a8a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">AO</text>
<text x="240" y="360" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Analog output</text>
<text x="440" y="360" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">4 to 20 mA</text>
<text x="640" y="360" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Valve positioner, VFD speed</text>
<text x="400" y="425" font-size="18" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Inputs bring field status in; outputs send commands out.</text>
</svg>
